title: Drift Creek Camp

services.name: DCC Disc Golf Tournament
services.desc: We just did not get enough participants signed up, but we will try again next year! Join us for a casual tournament at Drift Creek Camp! The tournament will be played on DCC’s 12-hole course Saturday, August 22. Saturday’s competition will include three rounds, 36 holes total. Players will be competing against those in their division, but hole assignments will be mixed during the tournament. Participants, and accompanying guests, can choose to either participate in Saturday’s events only or come early on Friday, August 21 to enjoy a summer evening at camp. Evening attendees are invited to play a for-fun glow round Friday night. Dinner and breakfast served for Friday night guests and lunch

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Plans are in the works for another season of Summer Camp! With a rich tradition of providing programs for youth for generations, the hope is to honor the legacy established by camp’s founders in the early 1960s. We strive to make DCC programs be an enriching experience for all ages. Our hope is that the camp experience will foster wonder, nurture relationships, build community, and be a place where youth feel supported in their journey towards faith, discovering God’s goodness along the way! Our hope is that DCC will feel like a comfy home away from home, where everyone has a place at the table! We are seeking creative young adults who are passionate about working together to put kids first

services.name: Fall Quilting Retreat
services.desc: Please note: We have limited options for main floor sleeping spaces. There are just two sleeping quarters on the main floor. Each room has a queen bed and a twin bed. If you are able to do stairs, we appreciate your flexibility in being willing to sleep upstairs. We have two rooms on the second floor that have 24-hour electricity. If you have a CPAP and have the option of bringing a battery back-up, it is helpful. Camp now also owns two portable batteries so sleeping options have increased for other areas of the lodge. YAY!
